title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
廣西鄉試錄序
洪惟
皇上協
天敷極文明之化浹邇曁遠今玆
己酉復當鄉試之期惟廣西
監臨御史王士翹慶逢
鴻典乃播宣
===
上德用揚作人之懿以興起百執
事復飭章度俾百執事得各
因職舒効用成以人事
君之忠簾内外罔弗共焉先是巡
按御史蕭世延程用擴式授
事責成縅儀諸方禮聘儒臣
右都御史張岳昔柄文鐸再
punctuated:
廣西鄉試錄序

洪惟皇上協天敷極，文明之化浹邇曁遠。今玆己酉，復當鄉試之期。惟廣西監臨御史王士翹慶逢鴻典，乃播宣上德，用揚作人之懿，以興起百執事；復飭章度，俾百執事得各因職舒効，用成以人事君之忠。簾内外罔弗共焉。

先是，巡按御史蕭世延、程用擴，式授事責成，縅儀諸方，禮聘儒臣。右都御史張岳昔柄文鐸，再
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Guangxi Provincial Examination

We reverently reflect that His Majesty, in accord with Heaven, establishes the supreme standard, and the transforming influence of his cultured rule permeates places both near and far. This year, jiyou [1549], the time for the Provincial Examination has come round again. Wang Shiqiao, the censor serving as Supervising Official in Guangxi, rejoiced to encounter this grand occasion. He proclaimed the sovereign’s virtue, extolling his fine purpose of cultivating worthy men and thereby inspiring all the officials engaged in the examination. He also put the regulations in order, enabling each official to exercise his abilities in accordance with his duties and thus fulfill the loyal purpose of serving the ruler by providing him with worthy men. All those serving inside and outside the examination curtain joined in this endeavor.

Previously, Regional Inspecting Censors Xiao Shiyan and Cheng Yongkuo had duly assigned duties and demanded their fulfillment, arranged the formalities in every quarter [?], and courteously invited scholarly officials. Zhang Yue, Right Censor-in-Chief, had formerly wielded the bell of literary instruction and again …

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
振武戈邇復兼制風敎維新
兵部右侍郎兼右副都御史
歐陽必進肅清方隅表宣文
化士無警奪顓攻術業太保
總兵官平江伯陳圭克佐成
焉珊與敎諭林高岡至則謬
主考試同考試則學正吳時
===
昭敎諭江汝楫馬進階蕭祥
庚林以毅聞實提調則左布
政使鄭漳右叅政魏良輔監
試則副使沈宏僉事何中行
旣鎖院進提學僉事謝少南
遴簡士千有百人三試之奉
制額擢五十五人錄其名及文以
punctuated:
振武戈，邇復兼制，風敎維新。兵部右侍郎兼右副都御史歐陽必進，肅清方隅，表宣文化，士無警奪，顓攻術業。太保、總兵官、平江伯陳圭克佐成焉。
珊與敎諭林高岡至，則謬主考試。同考試則學正吳時昭，敎諭江汝楫、馬進階、蕭祥庚、林以毅、聞實。提調則左布政使鄭漳、右叅政魏良輔。監試則副使沈宏、僉事何中行。
旣鎖院，進提學僉事謝少南遴簡士千有百人，三試之。奉制額，擢五十五人，錄其名及文以
translation_en:
…wielded the weapons of war; recently he again assumed concurrent command, renewing moral instruction. Ouyang Bijin, Right Vice Minister of War and concurrently Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, pacified the region and promoted civil culture, so that scholars could concentrate on their studies without disruption from alarms. Chen Gui, Grand Guardian, Regional Commander, and Earl of Pingjiang, ably assisted in accomplishing this.
When I, Shan, arrived with Lin Gaogang, Instructor, we were undeservedly entrusted with serving as Examiners. The Associate Examiners were Wu Shizhao, School Director, and the Instructors Jiang Ruji, Ma Jinjie, Xiao Xianggeng, Lin Yiyi, and Wen Shi. The Proctors were Zheng Zhang, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Wei Liangfu, Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner. Those overseeing the examination were Shen Hong, Surveillance Vice Commissioner, and He Zhongxing, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner.
Once the examination compound had been sealed, we admitted the eleven hundred candidates selected by Xie Shaonan, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner in charge of education, and examined them in three sessions. In accordance with the quota prescribed by imperial command, we selected fifty-five men and recorded their names and compositions in order to…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
獻珊以例僭序篇首夫廣西嶺
徼之地其極界去
京師萬里冠裳文物由漢而下
漸同中州至唐柳宗元始教
爲進士業史稱湘南之士執
經其門爲文多中程度然唯
其文而已矣宋張栻爲靜江
===
乃闡濂洛關閩之說訓教學
徒朱熹謂其明義反本遵先
王之遺意文士駸駸有興第
時值偏安王化無本君子有
遺憾焉仰惟我
太祖高皇帝用夏變夷紀綱四方
廣西内附於是
punctuated:
獻。珊以例僭序篇首。夫廣西嶺徼之地，其極界去京師萬里。冠裳文物，由漢而下，漸同中州。至唐，柳宗元始教爲進士業。史稱湘南之士執經其門，爲文多中程度，然唯其文而已矣。宋張栻爲靜江，乃闡濂洛關閩之說，訓教學徒。朱熹謂其明義反本，遵先王之遺意。文士駸駸有興，第時值偏安，王化無本，君子有遺憾焉。
仰惟我太祖高皇帝用夏變夷，紀綱四方，廣西内附，於是
translation_en:
…to present it. Following established practice, I, Shan, presumptuously place a preface at the beginning of the volume. Guangxi lies on the frontier beyond the mountain ranges; its farthest boundary is ten thousand li from the capital. From the Han onward, its ceremonial dress and cultural institutions gradually came to resemble those of the Central Plains. In the Tang, Liu Zongyuan first taught preparation for the jinshi examinations. The histories relate that scholars from southern Xiang came to his door bearing the classics, and that their compositions generally met the prescribed standards. Yet this concerned literary composition alone. In the Song, when Zhang Shi governed Jingjiang, he expounded the teachings of Lian, Luo, Guan, and Min and instructed students. Zhu Xi said that he clarified moral principles and returned to their roots, following the intentions bequeathed by the former kings. Men of letters increasingly flourished. Yet this was a time when the dynasty maintained its rule in only part of the realm; kingly moral transformation lacked a foundation, leaving gentlemen with cause for regret.
Reverently considering our Emperor Taizu Gao, he transformed the non-Han peoples through Chinese civilization and established order throughout the realm. Guangxi submitted to imperial authority, and thereupon…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
王封官守無異齊魯蓋自漢入
中國至是始盡用中國之治
成祖文皇帝曁我
列聖相承一道敎化熈洽故其人
文由黃虞後亦至我
國家始開百八十餘年其間輔
弼端揆之臣往往迭出今卽
窮陬僻邑談道而謀義禮作
而行脩是孰使之然哉
皇上中興
德敎光被人文化成雖跂行喙
息之鄉胥陶鑄于禮樂鼓舞
于風聲矧如粵西冠裳文物
齊而中州若是乆遠者哉故
punctuated:
王封官守，無異齊魯。蓋自漢入中國，至是始盡用中國之治。成祖文皇帝曁我列聖相承，一道敎化熈洽。故其人文，由黃虞後，亦至我國家始開。百八十餘年，其間輔弼端揆之臣，往往迭出。今卽窮陬僻邑，談道而謀義，禮作而行脩，是孰使之然哉？
皇上中興，德敎光被，人文化成。雖跂行喙息之鄉，胥陶鑄于禮樂，鼓舞于風聲，矧如粵西冠裳文物，齊而中州若是乆遠者哉？故
translation_en:
…Princes were enfeoffed and officials appointed to administer the territory, just as in Qi and Lu. For although it had entered the Chinese realm under the Han, only then did it fully adopt Chinese governance. Emperor Wen, Chengzu, and our successive sage emperors continued one another’s work, unifying the Way and bringing moral instruction into harmonious accord. Thus, in the ages since the Yellow Emperor and Shun, its cultural flourishing began only under our dynasty. Over more than 180 years, ministers who assisted the sovereign and headed the government repeatedly emerged in succession. Now, even in remote corners and secluded towns, people discuss the Way and deliberate upon righteousness; rites flourish and conduct is cultivated. Who has brought this about?
His Majesty has brought about a restoration: his virtuous instruction spreads its radiance everywhere, and cultivated civilization transforms the people. Even lands whose inhabitants creep on feet and breathe through beaks are all molded by rites and music and stirred by the influence of his example. How much more so western Yue, whose ceremonial dress and cultural institutions have stood on a par with the Central Plain for so long [?]! Therefore …

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
〔淵〕觀諸士文藝其雄深雅健
蓋有得于宗元之緒如劉禹
錫所謂繁星麗天而芒寒色
正望而敬于五行者庶幾再
見且其語性命則窺從出之
源議政事則究躬行之實或
則經以闡微或確質以孚理
===
擴如奧如金響玉韻張栻所
為拳拳于往日者類亹亹然
發之詞端無疑礙無矯頗珊
竊歛衽豈唯齊魯之所與同
雖都人士炳炳蔚蔚何以異
哉因是而仰歎而俯思益有
感于
punctuated: 〔淵〕觀諸士文藝，其雄深雅健，蓋有得于宗元之緒。如劉禹錫所謂「繁星麗天，而芒寒色正，望而敬于五行」者，庶幾再見。且其語性命，則窺從出之源；議政事，則究躬行之實。或則經以闡微，或確質以孚理，擴如奧如，金響玉韻。張栻所為拳拳于往日者，類亹亹然發之詞端，無疑礙，無矯頗。珊竊歛衽，豈唯齊魯之所與同？雖都人士炳炳蔚蔚，何以異哉？因是而仰歎而俯思，益有感于
translation_en: … [Yuan 淵], observing these candidates’ literary compositions, finds them powerful, profound, elegant, and vigorous: they evidently carry forward something of Zongyuan’s legacy. What Liu Yuxi described as “the myriad stars arrayed in heaven, their rays cold and their colors true, looked upon with reverence among the five elements [?]” may perhaps be seen again. Moreover, when they discuss human nature and destiny, they glimpse the source from which these arise; when they deliberate on affairs of government, they investigate the practical substance of personal action. Some take the Classics as their standard to elucidate subtle meanings [?]; others, through solidity and substance, accord with principle. Expansive and profound, their writing rings like bronze and resonates like jade. What Zhang Shi cherished so earnestly in former days seems to flow tirelessly from their words, without uncertainty or obstruction, distortion or bias. Shan [?] humbly draws his robes together in respect. Are they merely on a par with the scholars of Qi and Lu? Even compared with the brilliant and accomplished men of the capital, how do they differ? Thus, looking upward in admiration and bowing my head in reflection, I am all the more deeply moved by …

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
皇上德化之應文敎之訖於戲盛
矣抑聞之
國家之選士非爲士榮已也
天工所需而萬化攸畀乃其責重
矣顧于始進不免程諸文藝
亦豈徒取諸空言已也孔孟
之學必成己而成物故曰夫
===
人幼而學之壯而欲行之夫
行之云者行其所學焉爾非
能亮
天工而宣萬化安所徵學然切近
精實取諸其身而已珊嘗考
諸張栻其告語粤西之士謂
心爲萬事之宗必收其放存
punctuated: 皇上德化之應、文敎之訖，於戲，盛矣！抑聞之，國家之選士，非爲士榮已也。天工所需，而萬化攸畀，乃其責重矣。顧于始進，不免程諸文藝，亦豈徒取諸空言已也？孔孟之學，必成己而成物，故曰：「夫人幼而學之，壯而欲行之。」夫行之云者，行其所學焉爾。非能亮天工而宣萬化，安所徵學？然切近精實，取諸其身而已。珊嘗考諸張栻，其告語粤西之士，謂心爲萬事之宗，必收其放，存
translation_en: …the response to His Majesty’s transforming virtue and the consummation of literary instruction [?]. Ah, how splendid! Yet I have heard that the state selects men of talent not merely to confer glory upon them. They are needed for Heaven’s work and entrusted with the myriad transformations: weighty indeed is their responsibility. At their initial entry into service, it is nevertheless necessary to assess them through literary accomplishment. But can this mean merely choosing them for empty words? The learning of Confucius and Mencius requires one to perfect oneself and bring other people and things to fulfillment. Hence the saying: “A person studies when young and wishes to put that learning into practice when grown.” Putting it into practice means simply practicing what one has learned. Unless one can assist Heaven’s work and give effect to the myriad transformations, how can one’s learning be demonstrated? Yet what is close at hand, precise, and substantial is to be sought only within oneself. I, Shan, have examined Zhang Shi’s teachings. In his admonitions to the scholars of Yuexi, he said that the mind is the governing source of all affairs: one must gather it back when it strays and preserve…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
其良謂天下之事皆人所當
為必自其視聽言動之間而
求諸君臣父子夫婦昆弟朋
友之實斯則孔孟之微言而
周程之大㫖取諸身而至足
推之事而有常粤西之先民
固聞之而今固傳之亦憾其
===
不克究施矣方今
全盛之日諸士對主司旣發之
文詞慨若自任珊竊感焉如
挹諸士于張栻之門而待之
于孔孟周程之途非敢取諸
其空言云爾况由此而升試
春曹奉
punctuated:
其良，謂天下之事皆人所當為，必自其視聽言動之間，而求諸君臣、父子、夫婦、昆弟、朋友之實。斯則孔孟之微言，而周程之大㫖，取諸身而至足，推之事而有常。粤西之先民固聞之，而今固傳之，亦憾其不克究施矣。
方今全盛之日，諸士對主司，旣發之文詞，慨若自任，珊竊感焉。如挹諸士于張栻之門，而待之于孔孟周程之途，非敢取諸其空言云爾。况由此而升試春曹，奉
translation_en:
…their innate goodness. He said that the affairs of the world are all things people ought to undertake: one must begin with one’s seeing, hearing, speaking, and acting, and seek the actual substance of the relationships between ruler and minister, father and son, husband and wife, elder and younger brothers, and friends. These are the subtle teachings of Confucius and Mencius and the great purport of Zhou Dunyi and the Cheng brothers. Sought within oneself, they are entirely sufficient; extended to affairs, they provide constant standards. Earlier generations in Yuexi certainly heard these teachings, and they are indeed transmitted today; yet it is regrettable that they have not been fully put into practice.
Now, in this age of flourishing prosperity, the candidates, responding to the presiding examiners, have expressed themselves in writing with an ardor that suggests they take this responsibility upon themselves. I, Shan, am privately moved by this. It is as though I were drawing the candidates into the school of Zhang Shi and awaiting them along the path of Confucius, Mencius, Zhou Dunyi, and the Cheng brothers; I would not presume to judge them merely by empty words. How much more so when, proceeding from here, they advance to examination at the Ministry of Rites and receive…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
廷問所以先資自獻者已即此
在可不慎乎哉不然則瑰奇
絕特之文雖無殊宗元乃其
人得無不可者乎主司過慮
復丁寧而不自已亦誠過望
他日輔弼端揆之臣有自是
科繼出大行張栻之說亮
===
天工而宣萬化以佐于
聖明之廷豈唯主司之幸亦廣西
無窮之光也詎不益盛矣哉
諸士勉旃是舉也右布政使
楊本仁掌使司以南署按察
右參將劉遠署副總兵事署
都指揮僉事李霖署都司皆
punctuated:
廷問，所以先資自獻者，已即此在，可不慎乎哉？不然，則瑰奇絕特之文，雖無殊宗元，乃其人得無不可者乎？主司過慮，復丁寧而不自已，亦誠過望他日輔弼端揆之臣有自是科繼出，大行張栻之說，亮天工而宣萬化，以佐于聖明之廷。豈唯主司之幸，亦廣西無窮之光也，詎不益盛矣哉？諸士勉旃！
是舉也，右布政使楊本仁掌使司，以南署按察，右參將劉遠署副總兵事，署都指揮僉事李霖署都司，皆
translation_en:
…the questioning at court: the means by which you first prepare to present yourselves already lie here. Can you fail to take care? Otherwise, even if your splendid and extraordinary writing were no different from Zongyuan’s, might you yourselves nevertheless prove unacceptable? The presiding examiner worries excessively and cannot refrain from repeating his earnest admonitions. Indeed, he cherishes the great hope that, in days to come, ministers who assist the sovereign and preside over government will emerge in succession from this examination cohort, put Zhang Shi’s teachings broadly into practice, assist Heaven’s work, and spread its myriad transforming influences, thereby serving the court of our sage and enlightened sovereign. This would be not only the presiding examiner’s good fortune but also Guangxi’s everlasting glory. Would it not make its flourishing still greater? Gentlemen, exert yourselves!
For this examination, Yang Benren, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner, was in charge of the Provincial Administration Commission; Yi Nan [?] served in an acting capacity over the Provincial Surveillance Commission. Liu Yuan, Right Assistant Regional Commander, acted as Vice Regional Commander. Li Lin, Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner, was acting head of the Regional Military Commission. All of them…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
防檢于院以外而俾無所擾
于內者也右參政潘噭右參
議康朗副使徐禎僉事趙塤
左參將王寵咸有事于蒼梧
兩江而督傳厲兵供衛百執
事以逮諸士與有勞焉左參
政范欽僉事楊濂署都指揮
===
僉事張武先期入賀
萬壽都督僉事副總兵沈希儀先
期調征海南然樂逢盛舉則
自覩興事胥交慶焉得附書
之
福建興化府儒學教授詹珊
謹序
punctuated:
防檢于院以外，而俾無所擾于內者也。右參政潘噭、右參議康朗、副使徐禎、僉事趙塤、左參將王寵，咸有事于蒼梧、兩江，而督傳厲兵，供衛百執事以逮諸士，與有勞焉。左參政范欽、僉事楊濂、署都指揮僉事張武，先期入賀萬壽；都督僉事副總兵沈希儀，先期調征海南。然樂逢盛舉，則自覩興事，胥交慶焉，得附書之。
福建興化府儒學教授詹珊謹序。
translation_en:
…guarded and inspected the area outside the examination compound, ensuring that those within suffered no disturbance. Right Administration Vice Commissioner Pan Jiao, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner Kang Lang, Surveillance Vice Commissioner Xu Zhen, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Zhao Xun, and Left Assistant Regional Commander Wang Chong were all engaged in duties in Cangwu and the Two Rivers region. They supervised relay transport and readied the troops, providing supplies and protection for all the examination personnel and the candidates alike, and thus shared in the service rendered.
Left Administration Vice Commissioner Fan Qin, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Yang Lian, and Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner Zhang Wu had departed beforehand to attend court and offer congratulations on the Emperor’s birthday. Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief and Vice Regional Commander Shen Xiyi had previously been dispatched on a campaign to Hainan. Yet, delighted to encounter this grand occasion, they rejoiced together on seeing the undertaking set in motion [?]; accordingly, their names may be appended here.
Preface respectfully composed by Zhan Shan, Instructor in the Confucian School of Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian.

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
湖廣常德府武陵縣儒學教諭聞實〔子虛貴州永寧衛官籍直隸合肥縣人丙午貢士〕
印卷官
廣西等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷胡仲仁〔體元雲南昆陽州人監生〕
廣西等處提刑按察司經歷司知事馬堯德〔伯仁浙江會稽縣人知印〕
收掌試卷官
桂林府知府胡岳〔宗高江西鄱陽縣人壬辰進士〕
梧州府知府翁世經〔可貞福建福清縣人乙未進士〕
受卷官
平樂府知府謝紘〔章甫浙江會稽縣人己丑進士〕

text:
曰俞咨伯汝作秩宗夙夜惟寅直哉惟
清伯拜稽首讓于夔龍帝曰俞往欽哉
其爾克紹乃辟于先王永綏民說拜稽首
曰敢對揚天子之休命
文王惟克厥宅心乃克立茲常事司牧人

不剛不柔厥德允修

===
樂具入奏以綏後祿
昭茲來許繩其祖武於萬斯年受天之祜
受天之祜四方來賀於萬斯年不遐有
佐
四海來假來假祈祈景員維河殷受命咸
宜百祿是何
春秋
春齊人陳人曹人伐宋〔莊公十有四年〕
秦人伐晉〔文公三年〕晉侯伐秦〔文公四年〕
punctuated:
曰：「俞！咨，伯！汝作秩宗，夙夜惟寅，直哉惟清。」伯拜稽首，讓于夔、龍。帝曰：「俞！往，欽哉！」
其爾克紹乃辟于先王，永綏民。說拜稽首，曰：「敢對揚天子之休命。」
文王惟克厥宅心，乃克立茲常事司牧人，以克俊有德。
不剛不柔，厥德允修。
詩
四之日其蚤，獻羔祭韭。
樂具入奏，以綏後祿。
昭茲來許，繩其祖武。於萬斯年，受天之祜。受天之祜，四方來賀。於萬斯年，不遐有佐？
四海來假，來假祈祈。景員維河，殷受命咸宜，百祿是何。
春秋
春，齊人、陳人、曹人伐宋。〔莊公十有四年〕
秦人伐晉。〔文公三年〕晉侯伐秦。〔文公四年〕
translation_en:
He said: “Yes! Ah, Bo! You shall serve as Minister of Ceremonies. Be reverent day and night; be upright and pure.” Bo bowed and knocked his head to the ground, yielding the appointment to Kui and Long. The Emperor said: “Yes! Go, and be reverent!”
May you enable your sovereign to carry on the work of the former kings and bring lasting peace to the people. Yue bowed and knocked his head to the ground, saying: “I venture to acknowledge and extol the Son of Heaven’s gracious command.”
King Wen was able to establish his heart firmly; thus he could appoint those who regularly administered affairs and governed the people, employing men of outstanding virtue.
Neither unyielding nor yielding, his virtue was truly cultivated.
The Book of Odes
In the fourth month, early in the season, they offer a lamb and sacrifice with chives.
All the musicians enter and perform, thereby securing blessings to come.
Give a shining example to those who come after; follow in your ancestors’ footsteps. For ten thousand years, receive Heaven’s blessings. Receiving Heaven’s blessings, you are congratulated from the four quarters. For ten thousand years, shall you not have assistance?
From all within the four seas they come; they come in throngs. The vast domain extends to the Yellow River. Yin received Heaven’s mandate, fittingly in every respect, and bears its hundred blessings.
The Spring and Autumn Annals
In spring, men of Qi, Chen, and Cao attacked Song. 〔Fourteenth year of Duke Zhuang.〕
Men of Qin attacked Jin. 〔Third year of Duke Wen.〕 The Marquis of Jin attacked Qin. 〔Fourth year of Duke Wen.〕

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
夏齊人伐我北鄙僖公二十有六年晉欒
書帥師救鄭成公六年冬公會晉侯宋
公衛侯曹伯莒子邾子滕子薛伯杞伯
小邾子齊世子光伐鄭十有二月巳亥
同盟于戲襄公九年
夏公會齊侯于夾谷公至自夾谷齊人
來歸鄆讙龜陰田俱定公十年叔孫州
仇帥師墮郈季孫斯仲孫何忌帥師
墮費俱定公十有二年
===
禮記
禮也者猶體也體不備君子謂之不成人
設之不當猶不備也禮有大有小有顯
有微大者不可損小者不可益顯者不
可揜微者不可大也故經禮三百曲禮
三千其致一也未有入室而不由戶者
是故情見而義立樂終而德尊
忠臣以事其君孝子以事其親其本一也
氣如白虹天也精神見于山川地也
punctuated:
夏，齊人伐我北鄙，僖公二十有六年。晉欒書帥師救鄭，成公六年。冬，公會晉侯、宋公、衛侯、曹伯、莒子、邾子、滕子、薛伯、杞伯、小邾子、齊世子光伐鄭。十有二月，巳亥，同盟于戲，襄公九年。

夏，公會齊侯于夾谷。公至自夾谷。齊人來歸鄆、讙、龜陰田，俱定公十年。叔孫州仇帥師墮郈。季孫斯、仲孫何忌帥師墮費，俱定公十有二年。

禮記

禮也者，猶體也。體不備，君子謂之不成人；設之不當，猶不備也。禮有大有小，有顯有微。大者不可損，小者不可益，顯者不可揜，微者不可大也。故經禮三百，曲禮三千，其致一也。未有入室而不由戶者。

是故情見而義立，樂終而德尊。

忠臣以事其君，孝子以事其親，其本一也。

氣如白虹，天也；精神見于山川，地也。
translation_en:
In summer, the men of Qi attacked our northern borderlands. (Twenty-sixth year of Duke Xi.) Luan Shu of Jin led an army to rescue Zheng. (Sixth year of Duke Cheng.) In winter, the duke joined the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Cao, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, the Viscount of Teng, the Earl of Xue, the Earl of Qi 杞, the Viscount of Xiao Zhu, and Guang, heir apparent of Qi 齊, in attacking Zheng. In the twelfth month, on the day transcribed as sihai [?], they jointly swore a covenant at Xi. (Ninth year of Duke Xiang.)

In summer, the duke met the Marquis of Qi at Jiagu. The duke returned from Jiagu. The men of Qi came to restore the lands of Yun, Huan, and Guiyin. (All in the tenth year of Duke Ding.) Shusun Zhouchou led an army to demolish the fortifications of Hou. Jisun Si and Zhongsun Heji led an army to demolish the fortifications of Fei. (Both in the twelfth year of Duke Ding.)

Book of Rites (Liji)

Ritual is like the body. If the body is incomplete, the gentleman calls it an incomplete person; if its parts are improperly disposed, that is equivalent to being incomplete. Ritual has major and minor forms, manifest and subtle forms. The major must not be diminished; the minor must not be augmented; the manifest must not be concealed; and the subtle must not be magnified. Thus there are three hundred principal rules of ritual and three thousand detailed rules, yet their ultimate purpose is one. No one enters a room without passing through its doorway.

Thus feelings are manifested and righteousness is established; when the music concludes, virtue is held in honor.

The loyal minister thereby serves his ruler, and the filial son thereby serves his parents: their foundation is one.

Vital energy like a white rainbow pertains to Heaven; spiritual essence manifest in mountains and rivers pertains to Earth.

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
之隆皆未有如我
太祖高皇帝之盛者也仰惟
功德高厚
身兼創守未易窺測然其
恢鴻略以啓再造之景運
垂燕翼以綿萬世之太平者必有道焉可得
而揚言之與程氏論王道必本之學術
孔子歎堯無能名固曰煥乎其有文章
然則學術文章亦可以窺
===
皇祖之萬一否乎伏聞
皇祖與待制秦裕伯論學術學士詹同論文章
聖謨洋洋固是道也當時或發之事業脩之播
告與夫臣工之所賛述亦可得而聞其
槩與詩書所稱二帝三王之道詳矣其
同符者可指言之與漢唐宋開造之迹
與其學術文章固無足論者恭惟
皇上中興
聖德
punctuated: 之隆，皆未有如我太祖高皇帝之盛者也。仰惟功德高厚，身兼創守，未易窺測。然其恢鴻略以啓再造之景運，垂燕翼以綿萬世之太平者，必有道焉，可得而揚言之與？程氏論王道，必本之學術；孔子歎堯無能名，固曰：「煥乎其有文章！」然則學術文章，亦可以窺皇祖之萬一否乎？伏聞皇祖與待制秦裕伯論學術，學士詹同論文章，聖謨洋洋，固是道也。當時或發之事業，脩之播告，與夫臣工之所賛述，亦可得而聞其槩與？詩書所稱二帝三王之道詳矣，其同符者可指言之與？漢唐宋開造之迹，與其學術文章，固無足論者。恭惟皇上中興，聖德
translation_en:
…and the flourishing of their government, none has ever equaled the greatness of our Emperor Taizu Gao. Reverently considering his lofty achievements and profound virtue, and how he combined in his own person the founding and preservation of the dynasty, we find these difficult to fathom. Yet there must have been a Way by which he extended his grand designs to inaugurate the glorious destiny of a world renewed, and bequeathed provision for his descendants to perpetuate peace through ten thousand generations. Can you expound it openly? Master Cheng, in discussing the Kingly Way, invariably grounded it in learning. Confucius, marveling that no one could adequately name Yao’s greatness, nevertheless said: “How splendid were his cultural achievements!” Can learning and literary accomplishment, then, also offer a glimpse of even a tiny part of our imperial ancestor’s greatness?

We have humbly heard that our imperial ancestor discussed learning with Academician-in-waiting Qin Yubo and literary composition with Academician Zhan Tong. His abundant sagely counsels surely embodied this Way. As for their expression at that time in practical achievements and their elaboration in proclamations, together with the accounts composed in praise by his officials, may we also hear their general outlines? The Way of the Two Emperors and Three Kings is set forth in detail in the Classic of Poetry and the Book of Documents. Can you identify and explain the points at which his Way accorded with theirs? The founding achievements of the Han, Tang, and Song, together with their learning and literary accomplishments, are assuredly unworthy of discussion by comparison. Reverently considering His Majesty’s restoration of flourishing rule, his sagely virtue…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
天縱學術文章淵源炳蔚光楊
前烈丕纘
祖謨我
皇祖申錫無疆之休至是益巍巍蕩蕩矣
聖祖
神孫授守一道必有所本與諸士子服濡
聖化有年願鋪張于篇以鳴
國家之盛
問經以載道學以窮經誦其文弗知其義
===
淆於衆莫折其衷謂之窮經可乎茲以
經學之疑與二三子訂之周官太卜掌
三易夏商之易取七八周易取九六何
不同也周易上經三十卦下經三十四
卦或謂以反觀之皆十八卦然與否與
孔子刪書斷自唐虞以下迄於周終於
秦誓泰誓費誓果可與帝王之書相繼
而並傳乎傳之後儒何以為古文今文
之辨詩三百始關雎也有謂詩有四始
punctuated:
天縱，學術文章淵源炳蔚，光楊前烈，丕纘祖謨。我皇祖申錫無疆之休，至是益巍巍蕩蕩矣。聖祖神孫，授守一道，必有所本與？諸士子服濡聖化有年，願鋪張于篇，以鳴國家之盛。

問：經以載道，學以窮經。誦其文，弗知其義，淆於衆，莫折其衷，謂之窮經可乎？茲以經學之疑與二三子訂之。《周官》太卜掌三易，夏商之易取七八，《周易》取九六，何不同也？《周易》上經三十卦，下經三十四卦，或謂以反觀之皆十八卦，然與否與？孔子刪《書》，斷自唐虞以下，迄於周，終於《秦誓》。《泰誓》《費誓》果可與帝王之書相繼而並傳乎？傳之後儒，何以為古文、今文之辨？《詩》三百，始《關雎》也，有謂詩有四始
translation_en:
…endowed by Heaven; his learning and literary accomplishment have profound sources and shine with brilliance. He glorifies the achievements of his predecessors and grandly carries forward his ancestors’ plans. The boundless blessings repeatedly bestowed by our imperial ancestor have now become still more lofty and far-reaching. The sagely ancestor and his divine descendant follow one Way in transmitting and preserving their heritage: surely this has a foundation? You candidates have long been steeped in the sage’s transforming influence. We ask you to expound this fully in your essays, proclaiming the flourishing state of our dynasty.

Question: The classics convey the Way; learning seeks to fathom the classics. If one recites their words without understanding their meaning, becomes confused amid competing opinions, and cannot adjudicate among them, can this be called fathoming the classics? We now put certain doubts concerning classical learning before you gentlemen for resolution. In the Offices of Zhou, the Grand Diviner has charge of the three Changes. The Changes of the Xia and Shang use seven and eight, whereas the Changes of Zhou uses nine and six. Why do they differ? The upper section of the Changes of Zhou contains thirty hexagrams, and the lower section thirty-four. Some say that, when hexagrams are considered together with their inverted forms, each section contains eighteen. Is this so or not? When Confucius edited the Documents, he began with Tang and Yu, continued down to the Zhou, and ended with the “Oath of Qin.” Can the “Great Oath” and the “Oath at Fei” truly stand in succession to the documents of emperors and kings and be transmitted alongside them? As the text was handed down to later scholars, on what grounds was the distinction between the Old Text and the New Text made? The three hundred poems of the Odes begin with “The Ospreys’ Cry” (Guanju). Some say that the Odes have four beginnings…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
者其說何居春秋之義微哉婉矣有謂
大義數十炳如日星者其要安在禮記
始於曲禮名曲禮者何義豈著作於曲
臺緇衣依倣論語作緇衣者何人曷拘
泥於援引月令紀時政紀王居紀方位
王制言爵位言官制言巡狩抑皆經世
不易之道否耶後世有孟氏易梁丘易
大小夏侯尚書歐陽尚書言詩者四家
各爲專門言春秋者三傳互相牴牾言
===
禮者后蒼大小戴王鄭異喙而爭鳴其
於聖經孰爲得其宗派也他如太玄擬
易與司馬氏之潜虛孰優湯征擬書與
河內女子之秦誓孰正馬鄭之發明衛
孔之序疏孰有功於毛詩范氏之集解
戴氏之解疑孰無媿於公穀皇熊諸氏
南北異派孰於經禮無背馳耶此皆經
學之大疑知道者所宜辨析其究言之
問忠孝生人之大端節義持身之大閑所
punctuated:
者，其說何居？春秋之義微哉婉矣，有謂大義數十，炳如日星者，其要安在？禮記始於曲禮，名曲禮者何義？豈著作於曲臺？緇衣依倣論語，作緇衣者何人？曷拘泥於援引？月令紀時政，紀王居，紀方位；王制言爵位，言官制，言巡狩，抑皆經世不易之道否耶？後世有孟氏易、梁丘易、大小夏侯尚書、歐陽尚書；言詩者四家，各爲專門；言春秋者三傳，互相牴牾；言禮者后蒼、大小戴、王、鄭，異喙而爭鳴。其於聖經，孰爲得其宗派也？他如太玄擬易，與司馬氏之潜虛孰優？湯征擬書，與河內女子之秦誓孰正？馬、鄭之發明，衛、孔之序疏，孰有功於毛詩？范氏之集解、戴氏之解疑，孰無媿於公穀？皇、熊諸氏，南北異派，孰於經禮無背馳耶？此皆經學之大疑，知道者所宜辨析，其究言之。

問：忠孝，生人之大端；節義，持身之大閑，所
translation_en:
…those who say this: what grounds are there for their explanation? The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals is subtle and indirect; yet some say that its several dozen great principles shine as brightly as the sun and stars. Where do its essentials lie? The Book of Rites begins with “Detailed Rules of Propriety” (Quli). What does this title mean? Could it be that the text was composed at the Qu Terrace? “Black Robes” (Ziyi) follows the example of the Analects. Who composed it? Why be constrained by its citations? “Monthly Ordinances” records seasonal government measures, the king’s places of residence, and directional positions; “Royal Regulations” discusses ranks of nobility, official institutions, and royal inspection tours. Are these all immutable principles for ordering the world?

In later ages there were the Meng and Liangqiu traditions of the Book of Changes, and the Elder and Younger Xiahou and Ouyang traditions of the Book of Documents. Those who expounded the Book of Odes belonged to four schools, each constituting a specialized tradition. For the Spring and Autumn Annals there were three commentaries that contradicted one another. Among those who expounded the rites, Hou Cang, the Elder and Younger Dai, Wang, and Zheng contended, each voicing a different view. Which of them grasped the authentic line of transmission of the sages’ classics?

Among other works, the Supreme Mystery (Taixuan) was modeled on the Book of Changes: how does it compare in merit with Sima’s Hidden Potential (Qianxu)? “Tang’s Expedition” (Tang zheng) was modeled on the Book of Documents: how does it compare in authenticity with the “Oath of Qin” transmitted by the woman of Henei? Of Ma’s and Zheng’s elucidations and Wei’s and Kong’s prefaces and subcommentaries, which contributed most to the Mao tradition of the Odes? Of Fan’s Collected Explanations and Dai’s Resolution of Doubts, which does justice to the Gongyang and Guliang commentaries? Among Huang, Xiong, and the other scholars of the differing northern and southern schools, who avoided departing from the canonical rites? These are all major unresolved questions in classical scholarship, which those who understand the Way ought to distinguish and analyze. Discuss them thoroughly.

Question: Loyalty and filial piety are the cardinal concerns of human life; integrity and righteousness are the great safeguards of personal conduct, the means by which…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
以扶綱常立人紀世道攸賴試稽往牒
與諸士商之仗節匈奴與志不忘宋者
其忠同乎陳情歸養與棄官尋母者其
孝同乎畏知却金與擲金不顧者孰優
千家待火與千畝給族者孰賢抑其所
遇時勢不同或出一念感激未必其蹈
于中庸否耶夫忠孝一道也盡忠晉室
者何以絶裾于親負名國士者何以辱
身于虜節義並用也抗表不屈者何以
===
有三上書之議輔政同心者何以有附
許史之譏漢庭師傅當時倚重觀槐里
令廷辱數言邪佞顯矣柳州惠政千古
流芳觀王叔文陳情一表悖謬甚矣是
數子者得失可言要之勢難曲全時不
我遇有當原情誅心者邪余觀甌駱既
郡風氣漸開賢材彙征後先表著若正
色立朝募兵衛國刻木祀母甘露降亭
亦可以言忠孝矣忤時謝病罵賊守城
punctuated: 以扶綱常，立人紀，世道攸賴。試稽往牒，與諸士商之：仗節匈奴與志不忘宋者，其忠同乎？陳情歸養與棄官尋母者，其孝同乎？畏知却金與擲金不顧者，孰優？千家待火與千畝給族者，孰賢？抑其所遇時勢不同，或出一念感激，未必其蹈于中庸否耶？夫忠孝一道也，盡忠晉室者何以絶裾于親？負名國士者何以辱身于虜？節義並用也，抗表不屈者何以有三上書之議？輔政同心者何以有附許史之譏？漢庭師傅，當時倚重，觀槐里令廷辱，數言邪佞顯矣；柳州惠政，千古流芳，觀王叔文陳情一表，悖謬甚矣。是數子者，得失可言。要之，勢難曲全，時不我遇，有當原情誅心者邪？余觀甌駱既郡，風氣漸開，賢材彙征，後先表著。若正色立朝，募兵衛國，刻木祀母，甘露降亭，亦可以言忠孝矣。忤時謝病，罵賊守城，
translation_en:
…by which the cardinal relationships and constant virtues are upheld and the bonds of human society established: upon these the moral order of the world depends. Let us examine the records of the past and discuss them with you candidates. Were the man who upheld his mission’s credentials among the Xiongnu and the man whose resolve never forgot the Song equal in loyalty? Were the man who submitted a statement of his circumstances and returned home to care for his elder and the man who abandoned office to search for his mother equal in filial devotion? Who was superior: the man who refused gold for fear that his conduct would be known, or the man who cast gold aside without a backward glance? Who was worthier: the man upon whom a thousand households depended for fire [?], or the man who provided a thousand mu of land to support his clan? Or did the circumstances of their times differ, with some acting upon a moment’s deeply stirred feeling, so that their conduct did not necessarily accord with the Mean?

Loyalty and filial devotion constitute a single Way. Why, then, did the man who devoted his loyalty to the Jin ruling house sever his robe’s hem to break away from his parent? Why did the man renowned as an outstanding servant of the state submit to humiliation among the enemy? Integrity and righteousness must be exercised together. Why, then, was the man who submitted an outspoken memorial and refused to yield criticized for presenting three letters? Why was the man who worked wholeheartedly with others in assisting the government reproached for attaching himself to the Xu and Shi families? The preceptor at the Han court was greatly relied upon in his day; yet consider how the Magistrate of Huaili shamed him at court: a few words made his wickedness and flattery plain. The benevolent administration at Liuzhou has left a reputation fragrant through the ages; yet consider the memorial setting forth the circumstances concerning Wang Shuwen: its perversity and error were extreme.

The merits and failings of these men can be discussed. Ultimately, circumstances make it difficult to satisfy every obligation, and the times may deny a person his opportunity. Are there cases in which we should make allowance for the circumstances, or condemn the intentions? I observe that, after the lands of Ouluo were made into commanderies, their customs gradually developed. Worthy and talented men came forward together, distinguishing themselves in succession. Such deeds as standing at court with a stern and upright bearing, recruiting troops to defend the state, carving a wooden image for sacrifices to one’s mother, and causing sweet dew to descend upon a pavilion may indeed be spoken of as loyalty and filial devotion. Defying the temper of the times and withdrawing on grounds of illness, reviling rebels while defending a city…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
還妾不取直金却賜請蠲郡賦亦可以
言節義矣不知亦視古相伯仲否也諸
士幸際
明時應茲掄選居常臧否古人詳矣矧同鄉
先哲尤在景仰顧所自期待當不止是
其詳著之以覘異時所樹立者
問綏衆保邦守令莫先禦侮敵愾將帥獨
重蓋聞古之守令將帥固有京師蒙福
而河内願留虎為却走而犬不驚吠野
===
麥獻瑞而三異化成其視民不忍欺人
不敢犯民不見吏路不拾遺者何如也
或雄虎視于山東或絕胡騎于塞北或
三十年遠却秦兵或一人不殺而下江
南其視雅歌投壺輕裘緩帶單騎見虜
西賊膽寒者何如也我
朝稽古立法文武並用故當時前後粤西諸
臣有民饑不暇請賑捐俸以活者有課
農興學禱雨隨應者又有衣冠入峒賊
punctuated:
還妾不取直金，却賜請蠲郡賦，亦可以言節義矣。不知亦視古相伯仲否也？諸士幸際明時，應茲掄選，居常臧否古人詳矣，矧同鄉先哲，尤在景仰。顧所自期待，當不止是。其詳著之，以覘異時所樹立者。
問：綏衆保邦，守令莫先；禦侮敵愾，將帥獨重。蓋聞古之守令將帥，固有京師蒙福而河内願留，虎為却走而犬不驚吠，野麥獻瑞而三異化成。其視民不忍欺、人不敢犯、民不見吏、路不拾遺者何如也？或雄虎視于山東，或絕胡騎于塞北，或三十年遠却秦兵，或一人不殺而下江南。其視雅歌投壺、輕裘緩帶、單騎見虜、西賊膽寒者何如也？我朝稽古立法，文武並用，故當時前後粤西諸臣，有民饑不暇請賑，捐俸以活者；有課農興學，禱雨隨應者；又有衣冠入峒，賊
translation_en:
…Returning a concubine without accepting payment, declining an imperial gift and requesting remission of a commandery’s taxes—these, too, may be called examples of integrity and righteousness. Yet we wonder whether they rank alongside the men of antiquity. You scholars are fortunate to live in an enlightened age and to participate in this selection. In your everyday discussions, you have assessed the merits and faults of the ancients in detail; how much more should you admire the worthies of earlier times from your own region. Yet what you expect of yourselves should surely extend beyond this. Set out your views fully, so that we may discern what you will accomplish in the future.
Question: In pacifying the people and preserving the state, none take precedence over prefects and county magistrates; in resisting aggression and confronting the enemy, commanders bear particular responsibility. We have heard that among the prefects, magistrates, and commanders of antiquity were those whose blessings the capital enjoyed, while the people of Henei wished to retain them; those before whom tigers retreated, while dogs did not bark in alarm; and those under whom wild wheat appeared as an auspicious sign and three extraordinary phenomena manifested the transforming power of their governance. How do they compare with those whom the people could not bear to deceive, whom others dared not offend, under whom the people never saw government runners, and under whom no one picked up property lost on the roads? Some gazed with a tiger’s might over Shandong; some cut off the Hu cavalry north of the frontier; some kept Qin’s armies far away for thirty years; and some subdued Jiangnan without killing a single person. How do they compare with those who sang refined songs and played pitch-pot, wore light fur robes with loosely fastened sashes, rode alone to meet the enemy, or struck terror into the western rebels?
Our dynasty has examined antiquity in establishing its institutions and employs both civil and military talent. Thus, among the officials who served successively in Yuexi, there were those who, when the people were starving, could not wait to request relief and gave their own salaries to keep them alive; those who encouraged agriculture and promoted learning, and whose prayers for rain were promptly answered; and those who entered the dong settlements in official cap and robes, and the bandits…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
隨以化者是皆守令之賢果有龔黃卓
魯之循良否耶有克靜江而禁止剽掠
者有掛印出鎮而秋毫無犯者又有平
兩江五谿而峒寨悉降者是皆將帥之
良果有伏波韓岳之風聲否耶逖矣南
服二者之選視內為重而民流戶泯甚
于昔時飛矢鳴鏑殆無虛日其故安在
玆欲使布列郡縣介胄封疆者咸得其
人果何道以致之諸士目睹衷惕有懷
===
久矣願明著于篇
問我
皇祖式昭丕訓有曰治兵始可以休兵講武始
可以偃武穆如遠哉固萬世
保大之鴻憲也乃若廣西則自昔用武之地
所不可一日而去兵者今試撮舉要害
莫如三江紛紛之議胡累日積歲卒無
畫一豈治兵講武未得其道邪夫斷藤
之寇最號劇猾乃今曠然空土旅人宵
punctuated:
隨以化者，是皆守令之賢，果有龔黃卓魯之循良否耶？有克靜江而禁止剽掠者，有掛印出鎮而秋毫無犯者，又有平兩江五谿而峒寨悉降者，是皆將帥之良，果有伏波韓岳之風聲否耶？逖矣南服，二者之選視內為重，而民流戶泯甚于昔時，飛矢鳴鏑殆無虛日，其故安在？玆欲使布列郡縣、介胄封疆者咸得其人，果何道以致之？諸士目睹衷惕，有懷久矣，願明著于篇。
問：我皇祖式昭丕訓，有曰：「治兵始可以休兵，講武始可以偃武。」穆如遠哉！固萬世保大之鴻憲也。乃若廣西，則自昔用武之地，所不可一日而去兵者。今試撮舉要害，莫如三江。紛紛之議，胡累日積歲卒無畫一？豈治兵講武未得其道邪？夫斷藤之寇，最號劇猾，乃今曠然空土，旅人宵
translation_en:
…were thereby transformed. These were all worthy prefects and magistrates; did they indeed possess the benevolent administrative qualities of Gong, Huang, Zhuo, and Lu? There were those who captured Jingjiang and prohibited pillaging; those who received their seals of command and went out to garrison their posts without allowing the slightest infringement upon the people; and those who pacified the Two Rivers and Five Streams, securing the surrender of all the cave settlements and stockades. These were all excellent commanders; did they indeed possess the bearing and renown of General Fubo, Han, and Yue? Distant indeed are these southern domains! Selecting men for these two kinds of office is more consequential here than in the interior. Yet people flee and households disappear to a greater extent than formerly, and scarcely a day passes without flying arrows and whistling arrowheads. Where does the cause lie? If we now wish to secure suitable men for every post throughout the prefectures and counties and for those who bear arms on the frontiers, by what means can this be achieved? You gentlemen have witnessed these things and felt alarm in your hearts; you have long harbored thoughts about them. Please set these forth clearly in your essays.
Question: Our imperial ancestor clearly proclaimed his great instruction, saying: “Only by putting the troops in order can one bring warfare to rest; only by practicing military skills can one lay arms aside.” How majestic and far-reaching! This is indeed a great rule for preserving the greatness of the realm for all generations. Guangxi, however, has been a place of military operations since ancient times, one that cannot dispense with troops for even a single day. If we now briefly identify its strategic points, none is more important than the Three Rivers. Why, despite the profusion of proposals over days and years, has no unified plan ultimately emerged? Could it be that the proper way to organize troops and practice military skills has not been found? The bandits of Duanteng were renowned above all for their ferocity and cunning, yet now the land lies open and empty, and travelers by night…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
征矣古田近邑往稱繁庶數十年來顧
爾頑梗此其故何哉時與勢殊邪抑所
謂治兵講武昔勤而今或弛邪說者謂
左右兩江經略已定所未備者節目之
詳若府江一帶與古田獷獠非別有區
畫未可但已然與否與夫平居而負天
下之責士之自待宜不多讓且鄉井之
間耳目時及必有抱百年無事之策者
況休兵偃武有司願聞固不得而默如
===
也
punctuated: 征矣。古田近邑，往稱繁庶，數十年來顧爾頑梗，此其故何哉？時與勢殊邪？抑所謂治兵講武，昔勤而今或弛邪？說者謂左右兩江經略已定，所未備者節目之詳；若府江一帶與古田獷獠，非別有區畫，未可但已。然與否與？夫平居而負天下之責，士之自待宜不多讓。且鄉井之間，耳目時及，必有抱百年無事之策者。況休兵偃武，有司願聞，固不得而默如也。
translation_en:
…travel on their way. Gutian, a nearby county, was formerly renowned for its prosperity and populousness, yet for several decades it has remained stubbornly defiant. What explains this? Have the times and circumstances changed? Or were military preparedness and martial training pursued diligently in the past but perhaps neglected today? Some maintain that the strategic arrangements for the Zuo and You Rivers are already settled, and that only the detailed provisions remain incomplete; but that the Fu River region and the fierce Liao people of Gutian require separate plans before the matter can be left to rest. Is this so or not?

Even in ordinary life, scholars bear responsibility for all under Heaven; in what they expect of themselves, they ought not readily to yield that responsibility to others. Moreover, these matters concern your own localities and regularly come to your attention through what you hear and see. Surely some among you have plans that could secure a hundred years free from trouble. Furthermore, the responsible officials wish to hear how troops may be rested and warfare brought to an end. You certainly must not remain silent.

text:
第壹場
四書
顏淵季路侍子曰盍各言爾志子路曰願
車馬衣輕裘與朋友共敝之而無憾顏淵
曰願無伐善無施勞子路曰願聞子之志
