There were reasons why the dynasty endured so long and suffered no troubles from the non-Chinese peoples. Our Emperor sees clearly across ten thousand li, repeatedly issues imperial pronouncements, and shows solicitous concern for distant corners of the realm. In establishing the laws of the empire and controlling its essential mechanisms, he has left nothing undone to sustain and protect the people of Guangxi. Thus, to settle these people in security as comfortable as bedding and as protective as swaddling clothes, and…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
忠誠圖報以永紓
國家南顧之勤者守令事也將帥責也守令
得人則民安食足將帥可無事矣將帥得
人則兵強盜息守令可卧治矣而所以監
督守令將帥者尤不可不加之意焉昔人
有言太守吏民之本又曰禹稷伊尹之志
苟得一縣亦可小試孫子古之良將也其
言曰視卒如嬰兒可與赴深谿視卒如愛
子可與之俱死知此則知守令之可以行
===
吾志而將帥之可以成功矣竊嘗因是而
有感焉論治非難識體為難如有用我願
執此以往執事以為何如
第五問
唐文迪
同考試官學正吳批談要害如親歷論經畧如宿將非
徒以文事鳴者
考試官教諭林批有識見有區畫可與論兵矣斯粵
西休兵之助乎
punctuated:
忠誠圖報，以永紓國家南顧之勤者，守令事也，將帥責也。守令得人，則民安食足，將帥可無事矣；將帥得人，則兵強盜息，守令可卧治矣。而所以監督守令將帥者，尤不可不加之意焉。昔人有言：「太守，吏民之本。」又曰：「禹稷伊尹之志，苟得一縣，亦可小試。」孫子，古之良將也，其言曰：「視卒如嬰兒，可與赴深谿；視卒如愛子，可與之俱死。」知此，則知守令之可以行吾志，而將帥之可以成功矣。竊嘗因是而有感焉：論治非難，識體為難。如有用我，願執此以往。執事以為何如？

第五問
唐文迪

同考試官學正吳批：談要害如親歷，論經畧如宿將，非徒以文事鳴者。

考試官教諭林批：有識見，有區畫，可與論兵矣。斯粵西休兵之助乎？
translation_en:
…and loyally seeking to repay the state’s favor, so as enduringly to relieve its anxious concern for the south: this is the business of prefects and county magistrates and the responsibility of military commanders. When suitable men serve as prefects and magistrates, the people are secure and food is plentiful, and commanders may have nothing to do. When suitable men serve as commanders, the troops are strong and banditry ceases, and prefects and magistrates may govern at ease. Particular attention must therefore be paid to those charged with supervising prefects, magistrates, and commanders. Someone in antiquity said, “The prefect is the foundation upon which officials and people depend.” It was also said, “With the aspirations of Yu, Ji, and Yi Yin, even someone entrusted with a single county can put them to a modest trial.” Sunzi was a fine commander of antiquity. He said, “Regard your soldiers as infants, and you can lead them into deep ravines; regard your soldiers as beloved sons, and you can face death together with them.” Understanding this, one understands that service as a prefect or magistrate can give effect to one’s aspirations, and service as a commander can achieve success. I have ventured to reflect upon this: discussing government is not difficult; discerning its essentials is difficult. If anyone should employ me, I would wish to proceed on these principles. What do you, honored examiners, think?

Fifth Policy Question
Tang Wendi

Comment by Associate Examiner Wu, School Instructor: He discusses strategic points as though he had visited them himself, and military strategy like a veteran commander. He is no mere seeker of literary renown.

Comment by Examiner Lin, Instructor: He has insight and plans for action; he is someone with whom military affairs can be discussed. Might this help bring an end to warfare in Guangxi?

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
考試官敎授詹批論兵策多出卓見非苟言者取之
蓋聞之才智之士有志于興世務豈徒然
哉明以照之隱微以疏解而通健以决之
礙塞以摧廓而裕是故天下無難處之事
無不可成之功惟夫見之弗審則疑疑則
阻廢墜之弊生矣行之弗勇則玩玩則弛
偏枯之患成矣易曰動而明雷電合而章
言威照之不可以已也經世務者亦于此
求之而已ゝ夫廣西亦飫壤也土田腴而
===
易耨山麓□流多產江四出而泉貨可通
民近質而繁訟罔作然而今日徵兵明日
理餉終歲文移強半居此此其故何哉無
亦諸夷爲之擾擾爾休兵偃武旣無其期
則治兵講武張皇而稽謀也者安可一日
忘
皇祖之訓哉且夷不可化而内邪然谷永恩信
烏滸冠帶國麒納土慶遠服屬是其樂生
之心與中國同也夷不可屏而外邪伏波
punctuated:
考試官敎授詹批：論兵策，多出卓見，非苟言者，取之。

蓋聞之，才智之士有志于興世務，豈徒然哉？明以照之，隱微以疏解而通；健以决之，礙塞以摧廓而裕。是故天下無難處之事，無不可成之功。惟夫見之弗審則疑，疑則阻，廢墜之弊生矣；行之弗勇則玩，玩則弛，偏枯之患成矣。《易》曰：「動而明，雷電合而章。」言威照之不可以已也。經世務者，亦于此求之而已ゝ。夫廣西亦飫壤也，土田腴而易耨，山麓□流多產，江四出而泉貨可通，民近質而繁訟罔作。然而今日徵兵，明日理餉，終歲文移，強半居此。此其故何哉？無亦諸夷爲之擾擾爾。休兵偃武旣無其期，則治兵講武、張皇而稽謀也者，安可一日忘皇祖之訓哉？且夷不可化而内邪？然谷永恩信，烏滸冠帶；國麒納土，慶遠服屬。是其樂生之心與中國同也。夷不可屏而外邪？伏波
translation_en:
Examiner Zhan, an Instructor, comments: “This essay on military policy offers many outstanding insights. These are no careless assertions. Accept it.”

I have heard that when men of talent and intelligence aspire to advance the affairs of the age, their aspirations surely are not empty. Through clarity they illuminate matters, unraveling what is hidden and subtle until it becomes intelligible; through vigor they resolve matters, breaking down obstructions until the way lies open. Thus there is no affair under Heaven too difficult to manage, no achievement impossible to accomplish. But when understanding is insufficiently discerning, doubt arises; doubt brings obstruction, and the evils of neglect and failure emerge. When action lacks courage, carelessness arises; carelessness brings laxity, and the affliction of one-sided paralysis takes shape. The Book of Changes says: “Movement and clarity: thunder and lightning unite and manifest themselves.” This means that awe-inspiring power and illumination must never cease. Those who manage the affairs of the age need only seek their guidance here.

Guangxi, too, is a fertile land [?]. Its fields are rich and easy to cultivate; its mountain foothills and □ streams yield abundant produce [?]. Its rivers branch out in all directions, allowing money and goods to circulate. Its people incline toward simplicity, and excessive litigation does not arise. Yet today troops are levied, tomorrow military provisions are arranged; throughout the year, well over half the official correspondence concerns these matters. Why is this? Is it not simply because the various Yi peoples cause disturbances? Since there is no prospect of resting the troops and laying down arms, how could we forget even for a day the August Ancestor’s injunctions concerning the ordering of troops, the practice of military skills, the vigorous display of might, and the deliberation of plans?

Moreover, can the Yi not be transformed and brought within our realm? Yet through Gu Yong’s benevolence and trustworthiness, the Wuhu adopted caps and girdles; Guoqi surrendered his territory, and Qingyuan submitted to our authority. This shows that their love of life is the same as that of the people of the Central Realm. Can the Yi not be driven back and kept outside? The General Who Calms the Waves …

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
標銅柱遠人稽首武襄度崑崙智高喪魄
是其畏死之心與中國同也夫樂生畏死
彼旣與木石殊則所以制馭而羈繫之者
必有道矣執事謂三江之議紛紛未一此
非愚生所得聞也然耳目所及則有可言
者請得而終言之廣西之有三江是締絡
之大經而風氣之攸萃也然其地則廣矣
西極融洛南抵交阯北分湘源東帶蒼梧
其間郡縣之措置堡寨之聨綿誠足以壯
===
雄偉之區扼衝要之津矣然山麓險阻或
不足容方軌林木茂密或不勝施剪伐近
地犖确而不可田則屯戍弗便也峻嶺斗
析而不易達則樵牧弗便也是以盜賊窟
穴其間夷性無恒喜人怒獸未可常理格
而為害滋蔓矣今舉左右兩江觀之自斷
藤平而左江之患十減其七何也山遠而
淵藪失憑江闊而踪跡易露舊日之峽為
無人之境矣故謂左江一帶經畫已定不
punctuated:
標銅柱，遠人稽首；武襄度崑崙，智高喪魄。是其畏死之心與中國同也。夫樂生畏死，彼旣與木石殊，則所以制馭而羈繫之者必有道矣。執事謂三江之議紛紛未一，此非愚生所得聞也。然耳目所及，則有可言者，請得而終言之。
廣西之有三江，是締絡之大經而風氣之攸萃也。然其地則廣矣：西極融洛，南抵交阯，北分湘源，東帶蒼梧。其間郡縣之措置，堡寨之聨綿，誠足以壯雄偉之區，扼衝要之津矣。然山麓險阻，或不足容方軌；林木茂密，或不勝施剪伐。近地犖确而不可田，則屯戍弗便也；峻嶺斗析而不易達，則樵牧弗便也。是以盜賊窟穴其間，夷性無恒，喜人怒獸，未可常理格，而為害滋蔓矣。
今舉左右兩江觀之，自斷藤平而左江之患十減其七，何也？山遠而淵藪失憑，江闊而踪跡易露，舊日之峽為無人之境矣。故謂左江一帶經畫已定，不
translation_en:
…set up bronze pillars, and the distant peoples bowed their heads; when Wuxiang crossed Kunlun, Zhigao lost heart. Thus their fear of death is the same as that of the people of the Central Kingdom. Since they delight in life and fear death, and thus differ from wood and stone, there must be a way to control them and keep them bound to our authority. You say that proposals concerning the Three Rivers remain numerous and divided. This is not something that an ignorant student such as I has had the opportunity to hear about. Yet within what I have seen and heard there are matters I can discuss. Allow me to finish presenting them.
The Three Rivers of Guangxi form the principal network binding the region together and are where its vital influences converge. The territory is extensive: westward it reaches Rong and Luo, southward Jiaozhi, northward it shares the headwaters of the Xiang, and eastward it borders Cangwu. The disposition of prefectures and counties and the continuous chain of forts and stockades are indeed sufficient to strengthen this imposing region and command its strategic crossings. Yet the mountain foothills are rugged, sometimes too narrow for carts to travel abreast; the woods are dense, sometimes beyond the capacity of axes to clear. Where nearby ground is stony and cannot be cultivated, maintaining garrisons is difficult; where lofty ridges are sharply divided [?] and hard to reach, woodcutting and pasturing are difficult. Consequently, bandits make their lairs among them. The native peoples are inconstant by nature: when pleased they behave as humans, when angry as beasts. They cannot be brought into line by ordinary principles, and the harm they cause spreads unchecked.
Now consider the Zuo and You Rivers. Since Duanteng was pacified, troubles along the Zuo River have diminished by seven-tenths. Why? The mountains are distant, so their refuges no longer afford protection; the river is broad, so their movements are easily exposed. The gorges of former days have become an uninhabited realm. Thus, to say that arrangements for the Zuo River region are already settled is not…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
爲無見損之益之唯潯州分閫使得兼制
于都泥武宣之界以塞盜賊之門戶南太
二郡特假開府節鉞之副以爲粵駱之表
裏亦庶幾紀綱之密者乎自近歲五都之
役右江之威十伸其九何也強者觸目于
京觀弱者俯首于輸納沿江之隘已爲往
來之孔道矣故謂四三年間道路稀警不
爲無據益之損之唯象州永福之間移建
一縣邑則聲援有恃西融慶遠之間別假
===
===
一節鉞則求應不虛亦庶幾經制之詳者
乎如此則明有所必照而夷情罔遁威有
所必伸而體勢其益尊矣雖然此二者若
不可已而可緩若在所當務而猶可待也
乃其最先莫如府江其最急莫如古田矣
夫府江何以言最先也是門庭之寇也平
樂而北三司控于會城龍江而南兩府扼
其總要而鳥鼠之穴顧盤亘其中悔禍無
日此可以不加之意邪間其沿江而盜往
punctuated:
爲無見。損之益之，唯潯州分閫，使得兼制于都泥、武宣之界，以塞盜賊之門戶；南太二郡，特假開府節鉞之副，以爲粵駱之表裏，亦庶幾紀綱之密者乎？自近歲五都之役，右江之威十伸其九，何也？強者觸目于京觀，弱者俯首于輸納，沿江之隘已爲往來之孔道矣。故謂四三年間道路稀警，不爲無據。益之損之，唯象州永福之間移建一縣邑，則聲援有恃；西融慶遠之間別假一節鉞，則求應不虛，亦庶幾經制之詳者乎？如此，則明有所必照，而夷情罔遁；威有所必伸，而體勢其益尊矣。
雖然，此二者若不可已而可緩，若在所當務而猶可待也。乃其最先莫如府江，其最急莫如古田矣。夫府江何以言最先也？是門庭之寇也。平樂而北，三司控于會城；龍江而南，兩府扼其總要。而鳥鼠之穴顧盤亘其中，悔禍無日，此可以不加之意邪？間其沿江而盜往
translation_en:
…is not without insight. As for what should be reduced or augmented, a separate military command need only be established at Xunzhou, empowered also to control the borderlands of Duni and Wuxuan, thereby blocking the bandits’ gateways. The two prefectures of Nanning and Taiping should be specially entrusted with authority as deputies to the governor’s military command, providing mutually supporting positions in the lands of the Yue and Luo. Would this not bring us close to a tightly ordered system of control? Since the recent campaign against Wudu, authority over the Youjiang has been asserted to nine-tenths of its full extent. Why? The strong have been confronted with the sight of mounds of enemy corpses, while the weak have bowed their heads and made their payments. The defiles along the river have already become thoroughfares for travel. Thus, the claim that alarms along the roads have been rare over the past three or four years is not without foundation. As for what should be augmented or reduced, relocating a county seat to a site between Xiangzhou and Yongfu would provide dependable reinforcement; separately granting military command authority in the region between Xirong and Qingyuan would ensure that appeals for assistance did not go unanswered. Would this not bring us close to a thoroughly worked-out system of administration and control? In this way, discerning oversight would assuredly reach its objects, and the circumstances of the indigenous peoples could not escape notice; authority would assuredly be asserted, and the standing and strength of the government would be further enhanced.
Nevertheless, these two measures, though seemingly indispensable, can be deferred; though seemingly necessary undertakings, they can still wait. The foremost priority is the Fujiang, and the most urgent matter is Gutian. Why call the Fujiang the foremost priority? These are bandits at our very gates. North of Pingle, the Three Provincial Commissions exercise control from the provincial capital; south of Longjiang, the two prefectures hold the strategic points. Yet these nests of birds and rats stretch across the land between them, with no day on which their occupants repent of their wrongdoing. Can we fail to give this our attention? As for the stretch along the river [?], the bandits often…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
往來自遠地東則富賀恭城西則永安脩
仁荔浦或百里而趨或數舍而至倏往忽
來皆無旬日之計驅而除之寧無法乎竊
嘗道聽適中之處為昭平鎭城堡差壯野
亦寛衍說者謂于此地宜如北方之制設
一遊擊屯兵數千以十之三泝流駐于廣
運以十之三沿流駐于龍門三分其衆聯
以百艘畫地為限截日為役俾絡繹江洋
之中旌旗相望金鼓相聞上下呼應如左
===
右手彼為盗者置足無所何時何地得肆
其掠舟之兇乎不唯不得肆而已彼失鹽
米之利旣窘生理兼受巡邏之密復遭捕
縛吾見革面聽招且不暇矣又何盗之能
為哉此一說也古田何以言最急也是腹
心之患也夫省城西北不踰一舍柳郡東
來纔接縣境而虎狼之毒顧根蔕其中鞠
頑有年此可以不為之所邪聞之縣之渠
魁往往刼挾良善阻其輸賦十年之前令
punctuated:
往來自遠地，東則富、賀、恭城，西則永安、脩仁、荔浦，或百里而趨，或數舍而至，倏往忽來，皆無旬日之計。驅而除之，寧無法乎？竊嘗道聽，適中之處為昭平鎭，城堡差壯，野亦寛衍。說者謂于此地宜如北方之制，設一遊擊，屯兵數千，以十之三泝流駐于廣運，以十之三沿流駐于龍門，三分其衆，聯以百艘，畫地為限，截日為役，俾絡繹江洋之中，旌旗相望，金鼓相聞，上下呼應，如左右手。彼為盗者，置足無所，何時何地得肆其掠舟之兇乎？不唯不得肆而已，彼失鹽米之利，旣窘生理，兼受巡邏之密，復遭捕縛，吾見革面聽招且不暇矣，又何盗之能為哉？此一說也。
古田何以言最急也？是腹心之患也。夫省城西北不踰一舍，柳郡東來纔接縣境，而虎狼之毒顧根蔕其中，鞠頑有年，此可以不為之所邪？聞之縣之渠魁，往往刼挾良善，阻其輸賦。十年之前，令
translation_en:
…come and go from distant places: from Fu, He, and Gongcheng to the east, and Yong’an, Xiuren, and Lipu to the west. Some hurry a hundred li; others arrive from several days’ march away. They depart and return suddenly, none planning to remain even ten days. Can there be no means of driving them out and eliminating them? I have heard it said in passing that Zhaoping Garrison occupies a central position: its fortifications are fairly strong, and the surrounding countryside is broad and open. Those proposing a solution say that here we should follow the northern system, appoint a Mobile Corps Commander, and station several thousand troops. Three-tenths should proceed upstream and be stationed at Guangyun, and three-tenths downstream at Longmen. Divide the force into three detachments, link them with a hundred vessels, mark out their respective areas, and fix the days of their duty. Have them patrol the river continuously, their banners within sight of one another and their gongs and drums within earshot, the upstream and downstream forces answering one another like the left and right hands. With nowhere to gain a foothold, when or where could these bandits give free rein to their violence in plundering boats? Nor would the result be limited to restraining their violence. Deprived of the profits from salt and rice, they would already be hard pressed for a livelihood; subjected also to close patrols and liable to capture and binding, they would, I believe, scarcely have time enough to adopt an outward show of submission and heed the summons to surrender. How could they continue their banditry? This is one proposal.
Why do I say that Gutian is the most urgent concern? It is a malady at the very heart. Northwest of the provincial capital, it is no more than a day’s march away; coming east from Liuzhou Prefecture, one immediately reaches the county boundary. Yet the scourge of these tigers and wolves has taken root there, and their obstinacy has been nurtured for years. Can we fail to take measures against it? I have heard that the county’s ringleaders frequently seize and coerce law-abiding people, preventing them from paying their taxes. Ten years ago, the magistrate…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
猶間至數歳以來徒事羈縻或叛或懷要
非一心之人從而攻之寧無成乎又嘗聞
麻陽之師連跨數省説者謂俟其收功移
而南向此不可失蓋靖州南指搗其腹心
武岡西出衝其肩腋而我全廣帥海南之
勝旅舉三州之勁卒數道並進彼區區一
隅腹背受敵顧此失彼將何以為謀乎第
見其進退維谷而已蓋武靖逼而南則退
失甌脫之□全廣張而北則進無獵獲之
===
場吾知洗心乞命且不暇矣又何邑之敢
據哉此又一説也是在今之經世務者留
心焉爾然唐韓愈氏有言嶺外夷獠尋常
亦各營生急則死聚相保德既不能綏懷
威又不能臨制以致攻劫侵暴在今日得
不有如其言者乎苟有之古田之叛拒固
當有別為之畫者矣宋紹興建議謂谿峒
綿亘非一州得專約束故遊民惡少之棄
本者商旅之避征稅者盜賊之亡命者往
punctuated:
猶間至。數歳以來，徒事羈縻，或叛或懷，要非一心之人。從而攻之，寧無成乎？又嘗聞麻陽之師連跨數省，説者謂俟其收功，移而南向，此不可失。蓋靖州南指，搗其腹心；武岡西出，衝其肩腋。而我全廣帥海南之勝旅，舉三州之勁卒，數道並進，彼區區一隅，腹背受敵，顧此失彼，將何以為謀乎？第見其進退維谷而已。蓋武靖逼而南，則退失甌脫之□；全廣張而北，則進無獵獲之場。吾知洗心乞命且不暇矣，又何邑之敢據哉？此又一説也。是在今之經世務者留心焉爾。
然唐韓愈氏有言：「嶺外夷獠，尋常亦各營生，急則死聚相保。德既不能綏懷，威又不能臨制，以致攻劫侵暴。」在今日，得不有如其言者乎？苟有之，古田之叛拒，固當有別為之畫者矣。宋紹興建議，謂谿峒綿亘，非一州得專約束，故遊民惡少之棄本者、商旅之避征稅者、盜賊之亡命者，往
translation_en:
…still came from time to time. For several years now, nothing has been done beyond maintaining loose control. They sometimes rebel and sometimes submit; in any event, they are not united in purpose. If we proceeded to attack them, could we fail to achieve results? I have also heard that the army at Mayang extends across several provinces. Those discussing the matter propose waiting until it completes its campaign and then shifting it southward. This opportunity must not be lost. A southward thrust from Jingzhou would strike their heartland, while an advance westward from Wugang would strike their flank. Meanwhile, our forces throughout Guangxi would lead the victorious troops of Hainan and mobilize the crack soldiers of the three prefectures, advancing simultaneously along several routes. Confined to their tiny corner, attacked from front and rear, and losing one position while defending another, what strategy could they devise? They would find themselves unable either to advance or to retreat. With forces from Wugang and Jingzhou pressing southward, their retreat would lose them the □ of the frontier buffer territory [?]; with Guangxi’s forces deploying northward, their advance would leave them no ground for plunder. I know they would scarcely have time to reform their hearts and beg for their lives. What county seat would they then dare occupy? This is another proposal. It remains for those who manage affairs of state today to give it their attention.
Yet Han Yu of the Tang once said: “The Yi and Liao beyond the mountain passes ordinarily each pursue their livelihoods; when hard pressed, they band together to protect one another to the death [?]. Virtue has failed to pacify them and win their allegiance, and authority has likewise failed to keep them under control, resulting in raids, plunder, encroachments, and violence.” Can there be no circumstances today resembling those he described? If there are, then the rebellion and resistance at Gutian surely require a different plan. A proposal made during the Shaoxing reign of the Song stated that the settlements among the mountain streams and grottoes extended so widely that no single prefecture could exercise exclusive control over them. Consequently, itinerants and unruly youths who had abandoned their basic occupations, traveling merchants evading levies and taxes, and fugitive bandits often…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
往由入交相鼓煽深爲邊患在今日又不
有如其議者乎苟有之則府江之出沒固
當有別爲之防者矣雖然事之來也勢有
淹速君子之動也時有利鈍故惟剛明之
才審勢而應待時而行易曰出而有獲何
不利之有正謂此也此固經世道者之所
素定粤西之民方喁喁然羣切望焉狂瞽
及此不知忌諱惟執事大其爲容幸甚
punctuated: 往由入，交相鼓煽，深爲邊患。在今日，又不有如其議者乎？苟有之，則府江之出沒，固當有別爲之防者矣。雖然，事之來也，勢有淹速；君子之動也，時有利鈍。故惟剛明之才，審勢而應，待時而行。《易》曰：「出而有獲，何不利之有？」正謂此也。此固經世道者之所素定。粤西之民，方喁喁然羣切望焉。狂瞽及此，不知忌諱，惟執事大其爲容，幸甚。
translation_en:
…often enter by these routes, inciting one another and becoming a grave menace to the frontier. Are there not, today too, circumstances like those described in that proposal? If there are, then the raiders who appear and disappear along the Fujiang surely require distinct measures of defense.

Nevertheless, as events unfold, circumstances may develop slowly or swiftly; when the gentleman acts, the timing may favor or hinder him. Thus only someone resolute and discerning can assess circumstances and respond, awaiting the proper moment to act. The Book of Changes says: “Going forth, one gains something; what could be unfavorable?” This is precisely what it means. Those who bring order to the world surely have their plans settled beforehand. The people of western Guangxi are now all looking up in eager expectation, fervently hoping for this.

In my rashness and blindness, I have spoken thus far without regard for taboos. I would count myself most fortunate if you, honored sir, would receive my words with generous forbearance.

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
廣西鄉試錄後序
嘉靖己酉當天下大比之歲
高岡被聘校文粵西錄成有
序監臨御史王士翹授高岡
以末簡高岡何言哉夫振飭
科條以軌度其眾惴惴焉蚤
夜以易仰成
===
聖天子求賢之
制此監臨者之心也百執事之
責也高岡何言哉高岡惟賓
興之典自周人三物之制不
行試言遂不可易後世之士
劫劫焉聲華是究而飭躬軌
道之意疎飾情而詭物深衷
punctuated:
廣西鄉試錄後序

嘉靖己酉，當天下大比之歲，高岡被聘校文粵西。錄成，有序。監臨御史王士翹授高岡以末簡，高岡何言哉？夫振飭科條，以軌度其眾，惴惴焉蚤夜以易仰成聖天子求賢之制，此監臨者之心也，百執事之責也。高岡何言哉？高岡惟賓興之典，自周人三物之制不行，試言遂不可易。後世之士，劫劫焉聲華是究，而飭躬軌道之意疎，飾情而詭物，深衷
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Guangxi Provincial Examination

The jiyou year of Jiajing [1549] was a year of the triennial examinations throughout the realm. I, Gaogang 高岡, was invited to assess examination essays in Guangxi. When the record was completed, it already had a preface. The Supervising Official, Censor Wang Shiqiao 王士翹, entrusted its final pages to me. What could I say? To enforce and put in order the examination regulations, thereby bringing the candidates into conformity with proper standards, and anxiously, morning and night, to fulfill [?] the sagely Son of Heaven’s ordinance for seeking worthy men—this is the concern of the Supervising Official and the responsibility of all the officials engaged in the examination. What could I say?

I reflect that, in the ceremony of honoring and recommending worthy men, once the Zhou system of the three categories of instruction [virtues, conduct, and arts] ceased to be practiced, examination through written expression became an established practice that could no longer be changed. Scholars of later ages anxiously pursue literary reputation and brilliance, while giving little thought to disciplining themselves and following the Way. They disguise their feelings, misrepresent things, and conceal their innermost intentions…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
而自澤或失則輕或失則淺
或失則卑夫帝王需材以用
世也而輕也奚以任也淺也
奚以受也卑也易以陵也即
得士若此國將焉賴哉是故
浮華者不可任以治取士而
得浮華焉猶獲乎赤箭青芝
===
也雖美無所用之高岡受聘
之初亦未嘗不惴惴焉蚤夜
以惕天地之生材也洪纖一
氣纖之不可爲洪譬則棘之
不可爲檟也聖王之用材也
小大異任小之不可爲大譬
則榱之不可爲棟也吾受提
punctuated:
而自澤，或失則輕，或失則淺，或失則卑。夫帝王需材以用世也，而輕也奚以任也？淺也奚以受也？卑也易以陵也。即得士若此，國將焉賴哉？是故浮華者不可任以治，取士而得浮華焉，猶獲乎赤箭青芝也，雖美，無所用之。
高岡受聘之初，亦未嘗不惴惴焉，蚤夜以惕。天地之生材也，洪纖一氣；纖之不可爲洪，譬則棘之不可爲檟也。聖王之用材也，小大異任；小之不可爲大，譬則榱之不可爲棟也。吾受提
translation_en:
…and embellish themselves. Some err in being frivolous, some in being shallow, and some in being base. Emperors and kings need talented men to serve the world. But how can the frivolous shoulder responsibility? How can the shallow receive a trust? The base are easily overborne. If the men selected are like this, on whom can the state rely? Thus, men of superficial brilliance cannot be entrusted with government. To select such men is like obtaining red gastrodia and green numinous fungi: beautiful though they may be, there is no use to which they can be put.
When I, Gaogang, first accepted the invitation to serve, I was indeed apprehensive, remaining vigilant morning and night. When Heaven and Earth produce talent, the great and the slight arise from the same vital force. Yet the slight cannot become the great, just as a thorn tree cannot become a catalpa. When sage kings employ talent, they assign different responsibilities to the lesser and the greater. The lesser cannot serve as the greater, just as a rafter cannot serve as a ridgepole. I have undertaken to wield…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
斤之任而入粵求材能無惕
乎或曰因材而篤天地生物
之仁隨材器使匠氏不得已
之意嗟乎士乎吾寧使人不
得不用不用不已而使人不
得已而用之乎我
國家養士百八十餘年
===
仁義禮樂亦旣浹洽
聖皇御極涵濡益深
聲敎四達夷夏渢渢乃今甌粵
之士人知飭躬崇學爭自澡
雪與日俱新蓄材待用視昔
爲盛頃高岡執策而來也自
衡湘而南觀粵之山盤礴周
punctuated:
斤之任而入粵求材，能無惕乎？或曰：「因材而篤，天地生物之仁；隨材器使，匠氏不得已之意。」嗟乎，士乎！吾寧使人不得不用，不用不已，而使人不得已而用之乎？
我國家養士百八十餘年，仁義禮樂亦旣浹洽。聖皇御極，涵濡益深，聲敎四達，夷夏渢渢。乃今甌粵之士，人知飭躬崇學，爭自澡雪，與日俱新，蓄材待用，視昔爲盛。頃高岡執策而來也，自衡湘而南，觀粵之山盤礴周
translation_en:
…the responsibility of wielding the axe and entering Yue to seek timber—could I be without apprehension? Someone said: “Nurturing each according to its capacities expresses the benevolence with which Heaven and Earth bring things into being; assigning each a use suited to its capacities expresses the craftsman’s need to work with what is available.” Ah, scholars! Surely I would rather make others feel they must employ me and cannot rest without doing so, than have them employ me only reluctantly, for want of an alternative?
Our dynasty has nurtured scholars for more than 180 years, and benevolence, righteousness, ritual, and music have thoroughly permeated the realm. Since the sagely emperor ascended the throne, his nourishing influence has grown still deeper. His civilizing teachings reach in every direction, abundantly suffusing both the non-Han peoples and the Chinese. Now the scholars of Ou and Yue all know to discipline their conduct and esteem learning. They vie to cleanse and purify themselves, renewing themselves daily and cultivating their abilities while awaiting employment. Compared with former times, they flourish more greatly. Recently, when Gaogang came here, staff in hand, traveling south from Heng and Xiang, he beheld the mountains of Yue massing and spreading all around…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
徧草木賁若紫翠丹青蔚不
可辨雲鬱霆蓄爲蒸爲澤又
渾凝閎奧珍詭中涵愈窮愈
不可測而其孤峰峻崿壁立
千仞竒矯絕塵濯濯乎若與
日星俱動也業已灑然異之
謂人生其間實鍾靈秀豈無
===
賢傑雋拔之士出而爲
國建經世之業者邪既而觀諸
士之文或鋪張帝王之道或
究極天人之理文不流放言
無枝葉篤實敷英詞旨震絕
炯炯乎若與星晶埒竒而淳
粹博練意語天出鎔謨笵誥
punctuated: 徧，草木賁若，紫翠丹青，蔚不可辨。雲鬱霆蓄，爲蒸爲澤，又渾凝閎奧，珍詭中涵，愈窮愈不可測。而其孤峰峻崿，壁立千仞，竒矯絕塵，濯濯乎若與日星俱動也。業已灑然異之，謂人生其間，實鍾靈秀，豈無賢傑雋拔之士出而爲國建經世之業者邪？既而觀諸士之文，或鋪張帝王之道，或究極天人之理，文不流放，言無枝葉，篤實敷英，詞旨震絕，炯炯乎若與星晶埒竒。而淳粹博練，意語天出，鎔謨笵誥，
translation_en:
…extending everywhere, with luxuriantly adorned vegetation, its purples, greens, reds, and blues so profuse as to be indistinguishable. Clouds gather densely and thunder stores its force, producing rising vapors and nourishing moisture. The mountains are also massive and compact, vast and profound, harboring marvels within: the further one explores, the more unfathomable they become. Their solitary peaks and precipitous cliffs rise sheer for a thousand ren, wondrously soaring beyond the dusty world, gleaming as though moving together with the sun and stars. Already I felt refreshed and marveled at them, thinking that people born amid such scenery must indeed embody its numinous excellence. Could there fail to be worthy, outstanding men who would emerge to accomplish great works of statecraft for the realm?

Then I examined the candidates’ writings. Some expounded the Way of emperors and kings; others explored to their utmost the principles of Heaven and humanity. Their compositions did not lapse into unrestrained effusion, and their language had no extraneous branches and leaves. Substantial and solid, yet blossoming with literary beauty, their diction and meaning were astonishing and extraordinary, shining as though rivaling the stars in brilliance. Pure and refined, broadly learned and practiced, with ideas and language arising naturally, they took the Counsels and Announcements as models to shape their writing…

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
析理入微則固躍躍乎渙焉
以釋也夫文之足以知人也
自昔言之其人狷者其文急
以怨狂者其文怪以怒纖者
其文碎夸者其文誕由中發
外人若自貌莫之或失也則
夫今日粤之諸士吾未睹其
===
貌而得其神情文固神情之
所注也沈雄者干城之才精
鍊者宗廟之器峻潔者命世
之英吾知其不爲狷不爲狂
不爲纖夸而重也無弗任也
深也無弗受也辟則大車以
載攸往而利也諸士之謂邪
punctuated: 析理入微，則固躍躍乎渙焉以釋也。夫文之足以知人也，自昔言之：其人狷者，其文急以怨；狂者，其文怪以怒；纖者，其文碎；夸者，其文誕。由中發外，人若自貌，莫之或失也。則夫今日粤之諸士，吾未睹其貌而得其神情，文固神情之所注也。沈雄者，干城之才；精鍊者，宗廟之器；峻潔者，命世之英。吾知其不爲狷，不爲狂，不爲纖夸，而重也，無弗任也；深也，無弗受也。辟則大車以載，攸往而利也。諸士之謂邪？
translation_en: …they analyze principles down to the subtlest detail, so that their meaning comes vividly forth and difficulties dissolve into clarity. That writing suffices to reveal a person has been said since antiquity: when a person is narrowly scrupulous, his writing is strained and resentful; when unrestrained, his writing is strange and angry; when petty, his writing is fragmented; when boastful, his writing is extravagant. What lies within manifests itself outwardly, as though each person were portraying himself, without any failure of correspondence. Thus, although I have not seen the faces of these candidates of Yue, I have apprehended their spirit and disposition: writing is indeed where spirit and disposition find expression. Those whose writing is profound and vigorous possess the talents to serve as shields and walls of the state; those whose writing is refined are vessels fit for the ancestral temple; those whose writing is lofty and pure are outstanding men destined to distinguish their age. I know that they are neither narrowly scrupulous nor unrestrained, neither petty nor boastful. In their gravity, there is no responsibility they cannot bear; in their depth, there is nothing they cannot accommodate. They may be likened to a great carriage bearing its load, finding advantage wherever it goes. Does this not describe these candidates?

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
皇上
仁合天地
道協黄虞
觀乎人文以化成天下求才圖
治遐荒靡遺而主司慎簡精
良企克
國用爾諸士行且對揚
===
明廷受祿
公朝其將何以答之邪君子曰
大德不官大道不器大信不
約夫階進之日受任之地也
如金在鎔一塵爲黷如駿在
馭九折弗回約不當如是邪
記曰先勞而後祿又曰凡學
punctuated: 皇上仁合天地，道協黄虞，觀乎人文以化成天下，求才圖治，遐荒靡遺，而主司慎簡精良，企克國用。爾諸士行且對揚明廷，受祿公朝，其將何以答之邪？君子曰：「大德不官，大道不器，大信不約。」夫階進之日，受任之地也。如金在鎔，一塵爲黷；如駿在馭，九折弗回。約不當如是邪？記曰：「先勞而後祿。」又曰：「凡學
translation_en:
His Majesty’s benevolence accords with Heaven and Earth; his Way harmonizes with that of the Yellow Emperor and Shun. He observes human culture to transform and perfect all under Heaven, seeking talent and striving for good government, overlooking no remote region. The examiners carefully select the finest men, hoping that they can serve the state. You scholars will soon respond to imperial favor at the illustrious court and receive stipends in public service. How, then, will you repay this?
The gentleman says: “Great virtue is not confined to an office; the great Way is not confined to a particular use; great trustworthiness does not depend upon pledges.” The day you advance in rank is the occasion on which you assume responsibility. Be like gold in the crucible, for which a single speck of dust constitutes contamination; be like a fine steed under the reins, which will not turn back even at nine bends in the road. Should your commitment not be like this [?]? The Record of Rites says: “First render service, and afterward receive a stipend.” It also says: “In all learning …

title: 嘉靖二十八年廣西鄉試錄
text:
官先事士先志爾諸士其益
懋平生所學志以先之勞以
成之用効忠於
國毋負主司今日達才之意云
江西廣信府鉛山縣儒學教
諭林高岡謹序
punctuated:
官先事，士先志。爾諸士其益懋平生所學，志以先之，勞以成之，用効忠於國，毋負主司今日達才之意云。
江西廣信府鉛山縣儒學教諭林高岡謹序。
translation_en:
…officials put duties first; scholars put purpose first. You scholars should apply yourselves still more diligently to what you have studied throughout your lives: let purpose lead you and effort bring your work to completion, thereby rendering loyal service to the state. Do not disappoint the intention of the presiding examiners in advancing talented men today.
Preface respectfully composed by Lin Gaogang, Instructor of the Confucian School of Yanshan County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi.
